verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into the Gusto product itself. What it does document is a way for external AI tools to act on Gusto: an official remote MCP server for connecting Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini to a Gusto account, a developer MCP server, and an agent-friendly CLI with bundled skills. These let outside agents reach Gusto data and draft payrolls, but none of them is an in-product assistant, so the 'built-in' requirement of the story goes unevidenced.
